reference_reads.reference: SWEAT COVERED BRION'S BODY TRICKLING INTO THE TIGHT LOINCLOTH THAT WAS THE ONLY GARMENT HE WORE
reference_reads.transcript: Sweat-covered Brian's body trickling into the tight-lying cloth that was the only garment he wore.

reference_reads.reference: THE CUT ON HIS CHEST STILL DRIPPING BLOOD THE ACHE OF HIS OVERSTRAINED EYES EVEN THE SOARING ARENA AROUND HIM WITH THE THOUSANDS OF SPECTATORS WERE TRIVIALITIES NOT WORTH THINKING ABOUT
reference_reads.transcript: The cut on his chest still dripping blood, the ache of his overstrained eyes, even the soaring arena around him with thousands of spectators were trivialities not worth thinking about.

reference_reads.reference: HIS INSTANT OF PANIC WAS FOLLOWED BY A SMALL SHARP BLOW HIGH ON HIS CHEST
reference_reads.transcript: His instant panic was followed by a small sharp blow high on his chest.

reference_reads.reference: ONE MINUTE A VOICE SAID AND THE TIME BUZZER SOUNDED
reference_reads.transcript: One minute a voice said and a time buzzer sounded

reference_reads.reference: A MINUTE IS NOT A VERY LARGE MEASURE OF TIME AND HIS BODY NEEDED EVERY FRACTION OF IT
reference_reads.transcript: A minute is not a very large measure of time and his body needed every fraction of it.

reference_reads.reference: THE BUZZER'S WHIRR TRIGGERED HIS MUSCLES INTO COMPLETE RELAXATION
reference_reads.transcript: The buzzers were triggered his muscles into complete relaxation.

reference_reads.reference: ONLY HIS HEART AND LUNGS WORKED ON AT A STRONG MEASURED RATE
reference_reads.transcript: Only his heart and lungs worked on at a strong measured rate.

reference_reads.reference: HE WAS IN REVERIE SLIDING ALONG THE BORDERS OF CONSCIOUSNESS
reference_reads.transcript: He was in reverie, sliding along the borders of consciousness.

reference_reads.reference: THE CONTESTANTS IN THE TWENTIES NEEDED UNDISTURBED REST THEREFORE NIGHTS IN THE DORMITORIES WERE AS QUIET AS DEATH
reference_reads.transcript: The contestants in the twenties needed undisturbed rest, therefore nights in the dormitories were as quiet as death.

reference_reads.reference: PARTICULARLY SO ON THIS LAST NIGHT WHEN ONLY TWO OF THE LITTLE CUBICLES WERE OCCUPIED THE THOUSANDS OF OTHERS STANDING WITH DARK EMPTY DOORS
reference_reads.transcript: particularly so on its last night when only two of the little cubicles were occupied the thousands of others standing with dark empty doors

reference_reads.reference: THE OTHER VOICE SNAPPED WITH A HARSH URGENCY CLEARLY USED TO COMMAND
reference_reads.transcript: The other voice snapped with a harsh urgency, clearly used to command.

reference_reads.reference: I'M HERE BECAUSE THE MATTER IS OF UTMOST IMPORTANCE AND BRANDD IS THE ONE I MUST SEE NOW STAND ASIDE
reference_reads.transcript: I'm here because the matter is of utmost importance and Brand is the one I must see. Now stand aside.

reference_reads.reference: THE TWENTIES
reference_reads.transcript: to the 20s

reference_reads.reference: HE MUST HAVE DRAWN HIS GUN BECAUSE THE INTRUDER SAID QUICKLY PUT THAT AWAY YOU'RE BEING A FOOL OUT
reference_reads.transcript: You must have drawn his gun because the intruder said quickly, "Put that away, you're being a fool."

reference_reads.reference: THERE WAS SILENCE THEN AND STILL WONDERING BRION WAS ONCE MORE ASLEEP
reference_reads.transcript: There is silence then and still wondering Brian was once more asleep.

reference_reads.reference: TEN SECONDS
reference_reads.transcript: Ten seconds.

reference_reads.reference: HE ASKED THE HANDLER WHO WAS KNEADING HIS ACHING MUSCLES
reference_reads.transcript: He asked the handler who was kneading his aching muscles.

reference_reads.reference: A RED HAIRED MOUNTAIN OF A MAN WITH AN APPARENTLY INEXHAUSTIBLE STORE OF ENERGY
reference_reads.transcript: A red-haired mountain of a man was an apparently inexhaustible store of energy.

reference_reads.reference: THERE COULD BE LITTLE ART IN THIS LAST AND FINAL ROUND OF FENCING
reference_reads.transcript: There could be little art in this last and final round of fencing.

reference_reads.reference: JUST THRUST AND PARRY AND VICTORY TO THE STRONGER
reference_reads.transcript: Just thrust and parry and victory to the stronger.

reference_reads.reference: EVERY MAN WHO ENTERED THE TWENTIES HAD HIS OWN TRAINING TRICKS
reference_reads.transcript: Every man who entered the twenties had his own training tricks.

reference_reads.reference: THERE APPEARED TO BE AN IMMEDIATE ASSOCIATION WITH THE DEATH TRAUMA AS IF THE TWO WERE INEXTRICABLY LINKED INTO ONE
reference_reads.transcript: There appeared to be an immediate association with the death trauma as if the two were inextricably linked into one.

reference_reads.reference: THE STRENGTH THAT ENABLES SOMEONE IN A TRANCE TO HOLD HIS BODY STIFF AND UNSUPPORTED EXCEPT AT TWO POINTS THE HEAD AND HEELS
reference_reads.transcript: To strengthen and enable someone in a trance to hold his body stiff and unsupported except at two points the head and heels.

reference_reads.reference: THIS IS PHYSICALLY IMPOSSIBLE WHEN CONSCIOUS
reference_reads.transcript: This is physically impossible when conscious.

reference_reads.reference: OTHERS HAD DIED BEFORE DURING THE TWENTIES AND DEATH DURING THE LAST ROUND WAS IN SOME WAYS EASIER THAN DEFEAT
reference_reads.transcript: Others had died before during the twenties and death during the last round was in some ways easier than defeat.

reference_reads.reference: BREATHING DEEPLY BRION SOFTLY SPOKE THE AUTO HYPNOTIC PHRASES THAT TRIGGERED THE PROCESS
reference_reads.transcript: Breathing deeply, Brienne softly spoke the auto-hypnotic phrases that triggered the process.

reference_reads.reference: WHEN THE BUZZER SOUNDED HE PULLED HIS FOIL FROM HIS SECOND'S STARTLED GRASP AND RAN FORWARD
reference_reads.transcript: When the buzzer sounded, he pulled his foil from his second startled grasp and ran forward.

reference_reads.reference: IROLG LOOKED AMAZED AT THE SUDDEN FURY OF THE ATTACK THEN SMILED
reference_reads.transcript: I rolled my eyes at the sudden fury of the attack, then smiled.

reference_reads.reference: HE THOUGHT IT WAS A LAST BURST OF ENERGY HE KNEW HOW CLOSE THEY BOTH WERE TO EXHAUSTION
reference_reads.transcript: He thought it was the last burst of energy. He knew how close they both were to exhaustion.

reference_reads.reference: BRION SAW SOMETHING CLOSE TO PANIC ON HIS OPPONENT'S FACE WHEN THE MAN FINALLY RECOGNIZED HIS ERROR
reference_reads.transcript: Priyans saw something close to panic on his opponent's face when the man finally recognized his error.

reference_reads.reference: A WAVE OF DESPAIR ROLLED OUT FROM IROLG BRION SENSED IT AND KNEW THE FIFTH POINT WAS HIS
reference_reads.transcript: A wave of despair rolled out from Iroeg, Brian sensed it and knew the fifth point was his.

reference_reads.reference: THEN THE POWERFUL TWIST THAT THRUST IT ASIDE IN AND UNDER THE GUARD
reference_reads.transcript: Then the powerful twist that thrust it aside in Under the Guard.

reference_reads.reference: MISTER QUILTER IS THE APOSTLE OF THE MIDDLE CLASSES AND WE ARE GLAD TO WELCOME HIS GOSPEL
reference_reads.transcript: Mr. Quilter is the apostle of the middle classes and we are glad to welcome his gospel.

reference_reads.transcript: Nor is Mr. Quilter's manner less interesting than his matter.

accuracy.reference_video_note: Video regressions use explicitly hashed PyAV-decoded PCM controls because this reference setup has no external ffmpeg; these are not same-encoded-container comparisons.

text_generation.method: Authoritative final SSE usage; decode=(completion_tokens-1)/(terminal_usage_time-first_visible_token_time). One warmup and five greedy 256-token completions, thinking disabled, no draft assistant. The 64-token post-fix smoke is excluded.
text_generation.interpretation: L4/SM89 tuned-route and capture defaults are not enabled automatically on GB10. Requesting graph replay alone offers little improvement. The matvec candidate changes greedy text and is not promoted. A substantial native GB10 performance gap remains.

remaining_failures: Native clean-corpus WER remains above the predeclared 10% gate, versus 7.83% in the independent reference.

Silence still generates text in both native and independent reference implementations.
